name: ZMM_ACTY_TXNS_DELETED
description: This is the activity table which stores the primary key of deleted rows of interactions,tasks and appointments.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description:
OBJECT_CODE is used for Activities Upgrade. Possible values are 
'INTERACTIONS', 'INTERACTION CONTACTS' ,'INTERACTION ASSIGNEES','INTERACTION_OPTY _ASSOC','INTERACTION_CMPN_ASSOC','INTERACTION_LEAD_ASSOC',
'TASKS', 'TASK CONTACTS' ,'TASK ASSIGNEES',
'APPOINTMENTS', 'APPOINTMENT CONTACTS' and 'APPOINTMENT ASSIGNEES'.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID1
columns.description: OBJECT_ID1 stores the Primary Key for Interaction, Task, Appointment and Interaction Associations  related to Activities

columns.name: OBJECT_ID2
columns.description: OBJECT_ID2 stores the OPPORTUNITY_ID,CAMPAIGN_ID,LEAD_ID in case of associations like 'INTERACTION_OPTY_ASSOC','INTERACTION_CMPN_ASSOC','INTERACTION_LEAD_ASSOC'

columns.name: OBJECT_ID3
columns.description:
OBJECT_ID3 stores the Interaction Id in case of associations like 'INTERACTION_OPTY_ASSOC', 'INTERACTION_CMPN_ASSOC',
'INTERACTION_LEAD_ASSOC', 'INTERACTION_SCMPN_ASSOC'

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
